fieldValues.title: The programme records the rank of its objectives, but not the reasons for most of its order
fieldValues.summary: Only rank 1 of the period's seven objectives carries a reason (decision 3c8b94d1: it enables the rest). Ranks 2 to 7 have none; epic priority is derived mechanically from them; order inside an epic is sub-issue position with no reason. The programme of works (068a0a8b) is the one order with reasons and owner confirmation. No working group charter holds a strategy, so no group orders its own work.
fieldValues.body:
- Period 'Focus 1: writing and memory' (from 2026-10-08): objective_rank lists seven objectives; only cba2c1cf states why it is first.
- clerk roadmap: epic priority P0/P1/P2 from objective rank; topup feeds in epic order, so a P2 group epic (semanticops.com#31) is fed last.
- Group charters (role records 834b61fd, 1fc9ce85): authority, boundary, budget, quorum, cycle, repos, domains; no strategy or stance.
- Programme of works 068a0a8b: nine steps with reasons; steps 1 and 2 confirmed (vignette 38c76e41) as sequence clerk#229; 'the rest of the order waits until this unit is done'. A suggestion on 2026-10-27 to move clerk#124 earlier on one day's evidence was withdrawn (owner vignette 6f4c40e6).
